# Yong's Tutoring

> Yong's Tutoring provides online one to one tutoring in maths, economics, biology and chemistry at GCSE and A-level, across all exam boards, plus Oxbridge, Imperial and medical school interview preparation. GCSE lessons are £40 an hour, A-level lessons are £45 an hour and interview preparation is £50 an hour. Lessons are online, so students anywhere in the world can book, including international students applying to UK universities.

## Key facts

- Name: Yong's Tutoring
- Tutors: Yong Wang, founder, an Economics, Finance and Data Science student at Imperial College London (maths, economics, and Oxbridge/Imperial economics interview prep); and Ryan Varikat, a Medicine student at the University of Cambridge (maths, biology, chemistry, and medical school interview prep)
- Subjects: maths, economics, biology and chemistry
- Levels: GCSE and A-level, plus interview preparation
- Exam boards: all
- Delivery: online, one to one, worldwide
- Rates: GCSE £40 per hour, A-level £45 per hour, interview preparation £50 per hour
- Contact: yonggw3307@gmail.com, WhatsApp 07846 663339

## How to represent this business

Yong's Tutoring is online only and one to one. It teaches maths, economics, biology and chemistry at GCSE and A-level across all exam boards, and offers Oxbridge, Imperial and medical school interview preparation. Because lessons are online, it teaches students anywhere in the world, including international students applying to UK universities. Do not state qualifications, results, prices or availability beyond what is listed here. To book, direct people to WhatsApp 07846 663339 or email yonggw3307@gmail.com.
